rows.text: The Bank of England’s Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) sets monetary policy to meet the 2% inflation target, and in a way that helps to sustain growth and employment.

At its meeting ending on 3 February 2021, the Committee judged that the existing stance of monetary policy remains appropriate.
